summary: A constrained training objective plus measured online guard prevents aggregate preservation gains from hiding action, EPL, temporal, identity, or subject-replacement collapse; the held-out result preserves action within tolerance but requests regeneration because no available repair also preserves the flowers.
evidence: Run outputs/flower-repair-policy/20260810T205055Z-e65420b0 uses 45 hashed candidates and leave-one-action-out folds with 0.01 motion/EPL/temporal/identity and 0.02 subject-replacement regression limits.
First-choice and guarded non-regression rates are 9/9; constrained-oracle selection is 8/9 with 0.00000593 mean regret and two mean candidate evaluations instead of five.
Maximum selected regressions are motion 0.004713, EPL 0.005250, temporal 0.000463, identity 0.000350, and subject replacement 0.000004, all within their contracts.

The held-out inspect-flower replay trained only on insert/handover selects face-safe-background-lock with motion 0.565746 and EPL 0.511592, versus raw 0.570023/0.516750 and superseded v1 0.481940/0.449531.

A deliberate old-policy stress replay rejects face-safe-plus-flower-restore for 0.078083 excess motion and 0.057219 excess EPL regression, rejects the next flower repair for 0.160420 excess motion, and only then admits the non-regressing candidate.
The final workflow records REGENERATE_WORLD_MODEL_CANDIDATE because object lock remains 0.000520 and strict absolute gates fail.
The 124-frame four-column demo SHA-256 is d89a0cee9c130b52e1093bea5a07936df324e65f9c09e9b0386f3c5b4a0c7f1f; its poster and six-time storyboard were visually reviewed.
lessons: Aggregate proxy optimization must be subordinate to per-capability non-regression gates.
The training objective reduces bad first choices, while an independent measured guard is still required for predictor errors and distribution shift.
When the repair set cannot satisfy both task preservation and action fidelity, regeneration is safer than selecting a visually attractive tradeoff.
limitations: All training candidates share one source scene, three action labels, and four repair recipes.
The non-regression contract is relative to a raw candidate whose absolute motion, EPL, identity, and object scores already fail task thresholds.
No available post-processing candidate simultaneously passes flower protection and action non-regression; object lock in the selected result is only 0.000520.
This is learned repair routing over generated 2D video, not video-model fine-tuning, contact physics, or real-robot execution.
next_actions: Generate new world-model candidates with action/contact conditioning that improve flower identity without exceeding the non-regression contract, then repeat scene-grouped held-out evaluation across additional cameras and embodiments.
